_about: Public-domain Samuel Thayer Spear (1812-1891), pastor of the South Presbyterian Church, Brooklyn, for the Word Hoard: his theology and pulpit writings only: The Law-Abiding Conscience (1850), his Civil War sermons (The Nation's Blessing in Trial, Radicalism and the National Crisis, The Duty of the Hour, Our Country and its Cause, The Punishment of Treason), a memorial of Mrs. Stranahan, Religion and the State (1876) and Meditations on the Bible Heaven (1886). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 89 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

spear-nations-blessing: The nation's blessing in trial: a sermon preached in the South Presbyterian church of Brooklyn (Brooklyn, W.W. Rose, printer, 1862)
spear-radicalism: Radicalism and the national crisis : a sermon preached in the South Presbyterian Church of Brooklyn, October 19th, 1862 (Brooklyn : W.W. Rose, 1862)

spear-our-country: Our country and its cause : a discourse preached October 2d, 1864 in the South Presbyterian Church, of Brooklyn (Brooklyn : "The Union" Steam Presses, 1864)
spear-punishment-treason: The punishment of treason : a discourse preached April 23d, 1865, in the South Presbyterian Church of Brooklyn (Brooklyn, [N.Y.] : "The Union" Steam Presses, 1865)
spear-stranahan: In memoriam. Mrs Mariamne Fitch Stranahan (New York, Printed by C. A. Alvord, 1867)
spear-religion-state: Religion and the state; or, The Bible and the public schools (New York, Dodd, Mead & company, 1876)
spear-bible-heaven: Meditations on the Bible heaven (New York : Funk, 1886)
